description: Feature 3.6 offline demo mode — full design contract (implementation requires live verification)

tiers.TIER_2: OFFLINE DEMO MODE — precomputed validated evidence, explicitly labeled

honesty_rule: A viewer must ALWAYS be able to distinguish LIVE from OFFLINE. Rendering precomputed results as live is a BLOCKER.

mode_state.storage: Streamlit session state (core/session.py SESSION_KEYS addition: 'demo_mode': str)

activation.ui_offer: When API unavailable, UI offers: 'Live API is unavailable. Switch to Offline Demo Mode?'
activation.never_trigger: APIValidationError (422) — user input errors must NOT trigger offline mode

banner.text: OFFLINE DEMO MODE — Precomputed validated result. No live model inference is being performed.
banner.style: prominent (st.warning / colored banner), persistent across pages in OFFLINE mode

PREDICT.arbitrary_input: REJECTED — show: 'Offline mode supports only prepared demo scenarios.'

EXPLAIN.behavior: show explanatory message that offline Explain requires a live backend; NO dynamic SHAP, NO fabricated values

WHAT_IF.behavior: show message; NO local heuristics, NO fake dynamic inference

MODEL_INFO.behavior: render metadata from static snapshot; label: 'Snapshot — model version 1.0.0, captured <time>'

MUSIC_TRENDS.behavior: runs normally from local dataset; labeled as locally computed (not an API snapshot)

recovery.path: periodic /health probe (or manual Retry button) → 'Switch back to Live' → demo_mode = LIVE
recovery.not_stuck: user can always return to LIVE when API is back; OFFLINE is never silently forced

implementation_scope_note: Design contract is complete. Frontend implementation (session key, banner component, offline evidence loader, per-page input locks) is specified and deferred to the live environment where Streamlit behavior can be verified. Marking offline_mode_implemented=false until then.
